title: DOW-UAP-PR078, "2 November 2020 [CALLSIGN] [CALLSIGN] Observes and tracks UAP 2 of 2"

interpretation_warnings: Callsigns in the original title are redacted, obscuring the specific military unit or platform involved.

No extracted text from the video itself — all facts derive from metadata and the CSV description provided by war.gov.
This is video 2 of 2 from the same incident; video 1 may contain additional context not reflected here.
